messages:
tess: deploy-bot started staged rollout v3.1.2 -> canary 12% across eu/us regions. change window until 06:00 UTC. please watch tokenizer and routing :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout begun: v3.1.2 -> canary=12% | regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1] | CL#5217
omar: heads up: a handful of user requests got misrouted to a legacy tokenizer service causing malformed tokens, spike visible in routing logs at t+9m
infra-bot: sample log: "WARN routing: unmatched-tokenizer-version -> request_id=req-cc3f". error rate 0.3% -> 1.8% in two AZs
neha: build notes: v3.1.2 swapped tokenizer config to tokenset=v2 which is not backward-compatible with some older client SDKs. we expected a compat shim but it was gated out of this CL
tess: ops: can we pause progression and circuit-break to avoid wider client impact?
deploy-bot: action: freeze rollout progression. canary stays at 12%. notifying #devex #support #eng-oncall
omar: mitigation options: (1) apply runtime compat shim accepting v1/v2 tokens (CL#5218), (2) pin tokenset back to v1 on canary (CL#5219), (3) route affected partitions away from canary for now
neha: quickest is pin to v1 (CL#5219) and then ship proper shim in follow-up. CL is just a config flip, build ETA ~8m
tess: agree. hold + pin to v1. also add changelog note: "hold: tokenizer config mismatch caused routing errors; pinned tokenset=v1 on canary"
deploy-bot: recorded: changelog_note_added=true | rollout_frozen=true
omar: QA: running repro suite for token edgecases against pinned image once deployed. will post summary in ~10m
neha: CL#5219 merged, image pushed: inf-runtime:tokenset-v1-5219 -> rolling restart started
infra-bot: autoscaler hold applied for canary groups during restart. expected pod restarts rolling slowly
omar: smoke: token errors dropped back to baseline on the sampled window. extended monitoring for 20m before resume
tess: plan: keep at 12% until 20m stable, then resume to 25% if no regressions. if errors return, full rollback to v3.1.1. everyone ok? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
neha: :+1:
omar: :+1:
tess: I'll update release notes and change window if we extend. tagging this thread for follow-up postmortem if we end up rollback.
